## 🧩 What you'll find here

- **Web scrapers & dashboards** for Brazilian government portals (Transferegov, SEI).
- **Document extraction** — contracts, settlements, accountability, special transfers, attendance stats.
- **Productivity automations** — e-mail dispatch, Excel reporting, payroll double-checking.

All tooling is **modular**: each repository folder is a self-contained tool with its own README..

> 🔒 Security: no credentials or sensitive data are ever committed to these repositories.**
